scene1_screen1.text: The moment the crown touches her head, light explodes — brilliant, emerald, ancient. Gasps ripple through the hall. The Archbishop stumbles back. A goblet clatters to the floor. Time fractures.

scene1_screen2.text: In the center of the chaos, she stands still. Crown tilted, eyes unfocused. Like the moment hasn't caught up with her yet.

scene1_screen3.text: Despite some awkward movements, the queen clearly enjoys her importance in this world, as if she had been waiting for this moment for a very long time.

scene1_screen4.text: Across the hall, Nicholas grips the marble railing. A sharp pulse tears through his chest — not pain, exactly, but binding. The mark beneath his uniform flares green, burning against skin and oath.

scene1_screen5.text: His family always served the crown. They have never chosen to, but they have always been chosen.

scene1_screen6.text: (internal) It’s done. Bound again. No choice. No freedom. As I was to her father — just the blood oath of my line, stretching centuries deep.

scene1_screen7.text: He lifts his gaze. The young woman on the throne doesn’t look like a ruler. Not poised. Not trained. Not raised here.

scene1_screen8.text: (internal) Everyone in the castle was talking that she lived abroad most of her life. The king insisted it was for her safety, her education. But now… she feels wrong.

scene1_screen9.text: The magic clings too tightly. Her presence burns too bright. She doesn’t feel like family. She feels… foreign.

scene1_screen10.text: The emerald light fades. The hall breathes again. Murmurs rise — low, confused.

scene1_screen11.text: (solemn) By crown and flame, let it be known — Queen Molly of the Ninth Flame now reigns.

scene1_screen12.text: Applause follows — brittle and forced. The nobility claps as duty demands.

scene1_screen13.text: Nicholas doesn’t move.  His eyes stay locked on her face. She smiles faintly — too faintly. Her fingers brush the crown as if expecting it to vanish.

scene1_screen14.text: Between them, faint green threads shimmer in the air. The bond. Alive. Binding. Final.

opts.text: Try to sever the bond — even if it hurts.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Nicholas inhales slowly. The pain recedes. Duty wraps around him like familiar armor.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (low) Then I serve. Even if she is chaos in a dress.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: He steps forward, composed. The mark on his chest dims — but the pull remains.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He stays rooted. The air thickens. The bond tightens like a net.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (measured) She may be the king’s daughter — but too much of her is unknown. And that makes her dangerous.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: The magic accepts her. But it doesn’t feel… right.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Nicholas grips his chest, channeling every memory, every technique — resistance passed down like prayer.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: The threads waver. Crack. Then snap back. Hard. He doubles over. Cold sweat on his brow.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Do not disrupt the sacred rite.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Nicholas steadies himself. The moment passes. The bond holds.

scene1_screen15.text: The bond between Queen and Advisor is sealed. Neither can betray the realm, nor each other. Nicholas composes himself. Crosses the floor.

scene1_screen16.text: (formally) Your Majesty. The coronation is complete. Training begins tomorrow. Before sunrise.

scene1_screen17.text: She looks at him — pale, unfocused. Half somewhere else.

scene1_screen22.text: He felt the presence of an alien world in the girl who now ruled the land he’d breathed since birth — a land she hadn’t even touched until yesterday.

scene1_screen23.text: (quiet) That word does not exist in our language.

scene1_screen24.text: The mark on his chest pulses once. Then stills.

scene1_screen26.text: Outside the stained-glass windows, the light shifts. Just for a second, the sun dims. Like something ancient just opened its eyes.

scene2_screen1.text: Molly rises, barefoot, hair a mess. She glides over to the mirror, grabs a comb, and starts brushing.

scene2_screen2.text: The door creaks open. A maid freezes on the threshold, eyes wide. The sight before her — a queen, awake and unsupervised — clearly borders on scandal.

scene2_screen4.text: Silence. One of the maids steps in stiffly, curtsying as if her spine might snap.

scene2_screen5.text: (tense): Your Majesty… you… you were supposed to wait for us.

scene2_screen6.text: (grumbling): Wait? For what? A royal alarm clock?

scene2_screen7.text: The maid sets down her tray and begins helping her dress, movements clipped, almost offended.

scene2_screen8.text: I’m sure your advisor will not approve of your behavior today.

scene2_screen9.text: I don’t think that’s within his jurisdiction.

scene2_screen10.text: You have much to learn about how a queen should behave… But it’s not my place to say.

scene2_screen11.text: By the time Nicholas enters, Molly is seated — half-dressed, halfway scowling, and currently being cinched into a corset she clearly resents. He stops in the doorway. Eyes narrow.

scene2_screen12.text: You dismissed protocol. And you allowed the maids to scold you.

scene2_screen13.text: The maid pales, quickly bows, and exits the room.

scene2_screen15.text: (stepping inside): The queen is not to greet the castle barefoot. Or disheveled.

scene2_screen16.text: I didn’t greet anyone. Just one maid. And I was getting ready, technically.

scene2_screen17.text: Nicholas walks to the window. Back straight. Arms folded behind him. She watches his reflection in the mirror — precise, reserved, unreadable. The perfect opposite of her.

scene2_screen19.text: (without turning) Today begins your formal instruction. History. Law. Ritual magic. Court customs.

scene2_screen22.text: He turns to face her. For the first time, something flickers behind the mask — not annoyance. Interest.

scene2_screen23.text: He extends a rolled parchment. The ink is absurdly neat. Every time block is accounted for.

scene2_screen24.text: Your path forward begins with structure. The magic of the newly minted queen grows stronger with each day of her reign. In addition, you will have to study Reputation, Dignity, and Restraint.

scene2_screen25.text: (taking the scroll) Three of my least favorite words.

scene2_screen26.text: She unrolls the parchment. Her expression shifts — just slightly. A flicker of weight, memory. A crack in her posture. This isn't her world. Not her rules.

scene2_choice1.text: You are a modern woman. How will you react to the training?

opts.text: Be defiant. Try to modernize the court.
Take it seriously. Commit to proper training.
Flirt. Who knows how long you’ll be in this world?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (smirking) How about I learn your customs — and you learn mine? I could teach you about calendars, project management… and sarcasm.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Nicholas exhales — not amused. But intrigued.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: He glances away. His posture says “disapproval,” but his silence says he’s listening.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (softening) Fine. Let’s do this your way. For now.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Nicholas inclines his head, a flicker of surprise in his eyes.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Discipline is the backbone of sovereignty.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: I was more of a middle-management girl. But I’ll try.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Respect blooms between them — tentative, but real.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (teasing) And what happens if I fail the etiquette exam? You lock me in royal detention?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Nicholas pauses. Just a second. His gaze lingers — a breath too long.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (quiet) Then I’d be forced to spend more… personal time correcting you.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She steps closer. Adjusts the collar of his jacket.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Then maybe you can teach me how people flirt in your world.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen6.text: He stiffens — embarrassed and… something else. He shifts, clears his throat, and looks away.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (strained) Your Majesty… with your charm, you’ll have no trouble. But now — we focus on foundations.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen8.text: His voice is steady. His ears are flushed.

scene2_screen27.text: The day stretches out — full of rules, rituals, pages, and posture. Nicholas watches her closely. Not just as a tutor. Something more.

scene2_screen28.text: She challenges. She questions. She rolls her eyes.  And somehow… he likes it.

scene2_screen29.text: As lessons end, she leans against a shelf, spent. Breath short.

scene2_screen30.text: He stands across from her, arms folded. Like a man reading a foreign book for the second time — and starting to enjoy the story.

scene2_screen31.text: (quiet) You are… not what I expected.

scene2_screen33.text: Silence stretches between them. Not cold. Not awkward.

scene2_screen34.text: Something else. Something electric. They look away at the same time.

scene2_screen36.text: (through the door) Your Majesty… a reminder. At sunset on the thirteenth day since your coronation… You are to receive the people.

scene2_screen37.text: Molly nods. Barely. Nicholas says nothing. But his eyes linger.

scene2_screen38.text: Less than two weeks remain. And something strange is beginning to spread across the kingdom…

scene3_screen1.text: Molly sits upright on the throne. Back straight. Crown steady. But her eyes drift. Beside her, Nicholas stands — still as a statue. Watchful. Unyielding.

scene3_screen2.text: (quietly) Today’s audience is not for citizens. You face two provincial governors — the voices of half the realm.

scene3_screen3.text: Two figures approach, cloaks brushing stone. One bears the sigil of the Grainlands. The other — the joint crest of the Capital and the Scientific District.

scene3_screen4.text: (dry) And while training may not have covered this, know that I’m here… should you need guidance.

scene3_screen5.text: (tense whisper) Not helping. I don’t even know which one is which. So yes — I’ll be relying on you.

scene3_screen6.text: Your Majesty. I speak for the Grainlands. Since your coronation, the river has risen beyond its banks. Unnaturally. Three villages are underwater. The harvest is destroyed.

scene3_screen7.text: He extends a stalk of mold-blackened wheat.

scene3_screen8.text: If this continues, famine won’t be a question — it’ll be a fact.

scene3_screen9.text: Molly glances sideways at Nicholas. His stance is calm, but his jaw is set.

scene3_screen10.text: High Queen. Our city holds the heart of knowledge — and the kingdom’s livestock research. Half of the animals have turned violent. As if driven mad. They howl. They attack. And it happened… overnight.

scene3_screen11.text: His voice doesn’t shake from fear — but helplessness. The weight of someone trained to fix problems… who’s run out of answers.

scene3_screen12.text: A tense silence settles over the room. The nobles lining the walls shift uneasily. Molly’s knuckles whiten on the armrest.

scene3_screen13.text: Everyone sees it. So does Nicholas. He leans slightly toward her. Voice barely audible.

scene3_screen14.text: (quiet) All these terrible problems started after your coronation.

scene3_screen15.text: She doesn’t answer. But her eyes slide to the mirror-finished silver on the nearby wall. The crown glows — faintly. Unnaturally. Sickly green.

scene3_choice1.text: What do you advise her to say?

opts.text: Speak with honesty. Offer investigation and aid.
Offer vague comfort. Stall for time.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (measured) Tell them the truth. That we see them. And we’ll act.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Molly listened to everyone carefully, then stood up. Her voice steadier than she feels.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Your voices are heard. You will not face this alone. This court will act — and I will answer for what happens in this realm.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: The governors exchange glances. Still wary… but no longer hostile. They bow — deeper this time.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Trust rises. Respect grows. Molly’s reliance on Nicholas deepens.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (calm) Soften it. They’re frightened. Keep them steady.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Change brings turbulence. But we endure. Trust in the crown — as I trust in the wisdom of those before me.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: A pause. One nods. One doesn't. Their bows are short.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Nicholas stays silent. Molly looks to him — once. No help comes.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (uncertain) We… we will… I’ll look into this.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: The words fall flat. The governors bow — barely.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Trust in Molly weakens. So does hers in Nicholas.

scene3_screen16.text: The governors withdraw, cloaks whispering across stone. The room begins to clear — until the doors burst open.

scene3_screen17.text: A woman strides through the breach like a blade wrapped in silk. Eyes too bright. Smile too wide.

scene3_screen18.text: (to Molly) Be calm. Don't react to her, we were warned that she might come. I'll explain everything later.

scene3_screen19.text: So… this is the little queen who wears a stranger’s bones.

scene3_screen20.text: Molly tenses. Nicholas steps forward, hand near his blade. The witch doesn’t flinch.

scene3_screen21.text: (to Nicholas) And you — my favorite tragedy. Still leashed. Still noble. Still blind.

scene3_screen23.text: (laughing) Oh, they’ll come. They always do. But tell me — was it worth it? Serving bloodlines cursed by their own arrogance?

scene3_screen24.text: Guards arrive. Blades drawn. She doesn’t resist. Even as they seize her arms, her smile remains.

scene3_screen25.text: (shouting) Tick-tock, Molly. The crown isn’t a gift — it’s a grave. By the end of your twenty-first day… this kingdom will die.

scene3_screen26.text: She’s dragged away. Her laughter echoes after her.

scene3_screen29.text: (avoiding her eyes) Someone who should never have been free.

scene3_screen32.text: Molly doesn’t press — but she doesn’t believe him, either.

scene3_screen34.text: Then we move to the advisory chamber.

scene4_screen1.text: Molly stands near the hearth, arms crossed. Shadows flicker across her face. Nicholas shuts the door behind them, but doesn’t speak. He just watches her — silent, unreadable.

scene4_screen2.text: (quiet) I think you owe me an explanation. The witch. The bond. All of it.

scene4_screen3.text: (measured) I serve you because I must. Not by oath. Not by ambition. By blood. By magic.

scene4_screen4.text: He steps into the room — not pacing, not sitting. Just standing still. Grounded in centuries of duty.

scene4_screen5.text: My family has always served the Flameblood line. We’re bound to the royal house — not by contract, but by spell. An ancient tether passed from one heir to the next.

scene4_screen7.text: The bond accepted you. Even though there was no other choice.

scene4_screen8.text: He presses a hand to his chest. The mark beneath his tunic pulses — a faint green glow.

scene4_screen9.text: The magic recognized you. But I don’t know why. Or how.

scene4_screen10.text: Molly steps closer. Her voice low. Steady — but not calm

scene4_screen11.text: I feel it too. This… pull. Like gravity. But heavier.

scene4_screen12.text: It’s not love. It’s not loyalty. It’s compulsion. And if we follow it blindly — it becomes a prison.

scene4_screen13.text: Silence fills the room. But not emptiness. Heat. Tension. Something alive between them.

scene4_choice1.text: How do you react to the tension?

opts.text: Kiss him, let the bond become something more.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: She closes the space between them without hesitation.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Then let’s lie to the magic.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Her lips meet his — not tentatively. Not unsure. It’s instinct. Fire. Hunger. The kind of kiss that rewrites rules.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: A green light flares at Nicholas’s chest — and from her crown. Two forces uniting. And softening.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: His hand finds her hair. The room disappears. Just them. Just now.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen6.text: The bond pulses once. Then quiets. Not broken. Not forced. Just… still.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Molly inhales. Then exhales. And steps back.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: We’re here to rule. Not… to get lost in feelings..

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Nicholas nods. His jaw tightens. But he says nothing more.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Her composure cracks. Just a little. Her shoulders curl inward.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (cracked whisper) I don’t know how to do this.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Nicholas doesn’t touch her — but his voice is grounding.

scene4_screen14.text: He walks toward the map table. His hand rests on the capital’s mark.

scene4_screen15.text: (low) There’s something else. A weight in the air. Around you. Around the crown.

scene4_screen19.text: (tired) This’ll sound insane — but you asked for honesty. I hope you will believe me, because we live in a magical world. I’m not from here.

scene4_screen20.text: The words land like stone in water.

scene4_screen22.text: (flat) I come from another world. A world of buildings, paper, machines… and no magic. I worked in an office. I answered phones. And now — I’m here.

scene4_screen23.text: I don’t understand half of what you just said. And that terrifies me.

scene4_screen24.text: In my memory, words and movements — another world. I remember it until the moment when I was at work, and then I suddenly moved into the body of the queen.

scene4_screen25.text: (repentantly) More precisely, at that moment, the princess — that's how the maid explained it to me. She came to me the night before the coronation and told me about her role.

scene4_screen26.text: To put it simply, you’re talking to the soul of a stranger. The woman your magic bound to wasn’t me. Not really.

scene4_screen27.text: He stares at her. Like she just cracked the foundation of the castle.

scene4_screen28.text: (indignantly) How could you do this? Why didn't you say so right away?

scene4_screen29.text: I don't want to lie to you. In my world, I was nobody. Here I became a queen…

scene4_screen30.text: The tension in the room was palpable. However, it was noticeable how Nicholas was trying to understand what was happening.

scene4_screen31.text: I am very sorry that it happened.

scene4_screen33.text: He turns. Walks two steps. Stops.

scene4_screen34.text: (tense) There’s an old law. A myth. If the one who wears the crown is not of the blood… The land will die with them.

scene4_screen35.text: He looks at her again — not with anger. But grief.

scene4_screen36.text: (measured) Thirteen days have passed. That leaves eight. Eight days before collapse.

scene4_screen37.text: Molly turns to the fire. It's light flickers against her face.

scene4_screen39.text: I’ll study the binding. Find the witch’s origin. You — hold the throne.

scene4_screen40.text: He walks to the door. Then stops. Looks back.

scene4_screen41.text: (quiet) But Molly… There’s something inside you now. Something… not yours.

scene4_screen43.text: And I think I’m starting to like it.

scene4_screen44.text: The flames behind her leap — just a little. The crown on her head glints again. Too green. Too bright.

scene5_screen1.text: The 20th day of Molly’s reign is ending. Tomorrow, the kingdom dies.

scene5_screen2.text: Molly stands alone. Her cloak hangs open. Hands cold. She hasn’t slept in days. Moonlight paints the lake in cold silver. Everything feels too sharp. Too quiet.

scene5_screen3.text: Quickly realizing her place in this world, she accepted this fate and without even trying to escape, she decided that she could rule this world. However, everything turned out to be not so simple.

scene5_screen4.text: Books, scrolls, rituals — none of it worked. The truth is simple: she doesn’t belong. And her presence is killing the land.

scene5_screen5.text: (internal): I thought I could fake it. Wear the crown. Smile in mirrors. But people are dying. Because of me

scene5_screen6.text: She raises her hand. A flame bursts to life at her fingertips — fast. Eager. Too eager. The crown feeds her magic now. It whispers.

scene5_screen7.text: A voice glides through the trees — smooth, amused, venom-laced.

scene5_screen9.text: The witch steps from the mist. Cloaked in black velvet. Eyes bright with hate.

scene5_screen10.text: I watched your useless existence in your world, and I decided it would be fun to see what you did in this one.

scene5_screen11.text: I just wanted to see you be as useless on the throne of a kingdom I hate. One more night, and the kingdom dies — just as promised.

scene5_screen12.text: (low) What do you want from me now!? Why should I listen to this?

scene5_screen13.text: You got close to the descendant of my enemy, and I didn't like it.

scene5_screen14.text: The crown pulses on Molly’s head — green and wild.

scene5_screen15.text: Because my existence is not eternal and I considered it necessary to get rid of the kingdom.

scene5_screen18.text: The air snaps, the lake wind vanishes. Molly lifts her hand and the magic erupts — a raw torrent of light. The blast tears through the clearing.

scene5_screen19.text: Trees splinter. Bark scorches. The witch screams — flung like a broken doll. She crashes to the ground, coughing blood.

scene5_screen20.text: Nicholas bursts through the trees. Running. Then stops and sees the crater, the broken pines, the witch, and Molly — glowing, trembling with magic around her writhing like storm winds.

scene5_screen22.text: She turns. Her eyes are wild — not with rage, but fear.

scene5_screen24.text: (stepping back) You weren’t supposed to have this power.

scene5_screen25.text: I don’t want it. I just… I had to make her stop.

scene5_screen26.text: She steps toward him. The light fades just enough so he could see her again — not a weapon, but a girl who is afraid.

scene5_screen27.text: (quiet) I have a plan. We make her send me back. I leave — she wins. I’m gone and the kingdom survives.

opts.text: Calm Molly. Offer a rational counterplan.
Ask the witch what she wants.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (steady) No. Not like this. Let me speak to her. Let me try.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Molly lowers her hand a little.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (hurt) You don’t think I can handle her?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: The witch next to her began to move, she had clearly come to her senses.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (sharp, to the witch) What do you want in return?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (smiling through blood) You. On your knees. Still begging after all these years.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: She spits. Sparks flicker on her fingertips again.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Then we do this your way.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Molly meets his gaze. Relief floods her face.

scene5_screen30.text: The trees rustle. Then again. Figures emerge from the shadows.

scene5_screen31.text: Two provincial governors — their eyes blank, their hands wreathed in stolen magic. They are not themselves.

scene5_screen33.text: The battle erupts. Molly and Nicholas move as one — swift, deliberate, controlled. They try not to kill.

scene5_screen34.text: But the governors are lethal. The magic is unstable. The witch feeds their rage like an alcoholic drinks wine.

scene5_screen35.text: Nicholas takes a hit — a deep slash across his arm. He stumbles. The witch raises her hand.

scene5_screen36.text: A final blast — aimed straight at his heart.

scene5_screen37.text: Molly doesn’t think. Doesn’t hesitate. She throws herself between them. The spell strikes her full in the chest.

scene5_screen38.text: Silence. Nicholas falls to his knees. Cradles her.

scene5_screen40.text: His eyes lift. Something ancient breaks inside him. He rises. Draws his blade. Throws it.

scene5_screen41.text: The steel pierces the witch’s heart. She gasps and crumbles to ash.

scene5_screen42.text: The governors collapse — eyes clearing. The air stills. Nicholas drops beside Molly. Tears streak his face.

scene5_screen46.text: (weak) It’s not that easy to kill a soul from another world.

scene5_screen47.text: The crown on her head cracks. Then shatters. From within — a glowing vision takes form.

scene5_screen48.text: A memory — no, a truth. A young man — unmistakably of Nicholas’s line — walks with a girl beneath his station. She loves him. Dreams of being queen. But he turns away.

scene5_screen49.text: We don’t choose our destinies. Neither do you.

scene5_screen50.text: She leaves, learns magic, and casts a curse. The royal line shall forget. The usurpers shall wear the crown. And the rightful blood — shall serve, endlessly.

scene5_screen51.text: Nicholas stares at the vision. The sigil. The name. His name.

scene5_screen54.text: (surprised) Does this mean I have to be king?

scene5_screen55.text: He looks at the broken pieces of the crown. Then at her. The governors — now free — rise. Then kneel.

scene5_screen56.text: The kingdom needs a ruler. And now we remember who.

scene5_screen57.text: The night ends in silence. But not defeat.

scene6_screen1.text: This time, no fireworks. No music. No illusions. Only truth.

scene6_screen2.text: Nicholas stands before the throne. Straight-backed. Silent. Steady.

scene6_screen3.text: Not as an advisor. Not as a servant. As king.

scene6_screen4.text: The mark on his chest no longer glows. Not erased — fulfilled.

scene6_screen5.text: The provincial governors form a half-circle. Not a word is spoken as the crown is lowered onto his head.

scene6_screen6.text: It doesn’t flash. Doesn’t flare. It settles.

scene6_screen7.text: Let it be known — On the 21st day of Queen Molly’s reign, the kingdom was saved.

scene6_screen8.text: (solemn): And Nicholas of the Flameblood Line now reigns. By memory, by truth, and by will.

scene6_screen9.text: The people kneel. And then, slowly, rise.

scene6_screen10.text: Beside the throne stands Molly. She still looks like a queen, as a sign of the transfer of power to the true king.

scene6_screen11.text: Later, when the hall is empty — Just the two of them remain.

scene6_screen12.text: No crown between them. No magic. Only choice.

scene6_screen16.text: He steps toward her. No ceremony. Just gravity.

scene6_screen17.text: You saved this kingdom. You carried a crown not meant for you. And you brought us the truth.

scene6_screen18.text: He reaches into his cloak. A scroll — unsealed.

scene6_screen19.text: I want you to stay. Not as a guest. Not as an accident. But as my advisor. Formally. Permanently.

scene6_screen20.text: We both were bound. You by fate, me by blood. But only together… we rewrote the end.

opts.text: Accept. Bind yourself to the realm — and to him.
Stay by his side — but free.
Leave — explore this world on your own.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (steadily) Then I serve. But this time, by choice.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen2.text: He extends his hand. She takes it. A soft glow rises — not magic. Not duty. Just promise.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Their fingers close. A new bond begins.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (smirking) I’ll advise. I’ll meddle. But no vows. No seals.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Nicholas chuckles — a rare, real sound.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Then I’ll count myself lucky that you still choose me.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen4.text: They stand side by side — not bound. Just close.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (soft) I need to see more of this place. On my own terms.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Then go. And return when you’re ready.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen4.text: They don’t say goodbye. Not really. Because in this world — she’ll always leave a map back to him.

scene6_screen22.text: Nicholas ruled wisely. Fairly. His first decree: restore what had been broken. The fields. The minds. The memory.

scene6_screen23.text: He became the king history had been waiting for. Not because he was crowned. But because he had once served.

scene6_screen24.text: The kingdom changed. It became stranger. Smarter. Braver. Because the woman who never belonged had helped it become something new.

scene6_screen25.text: History remembers kings. But legends… Are born from the unexpected. Discuss the history of the crown and the future of the kingdom.
